arguments.script: var setup=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.GetSceneManagerSetup();var rows=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();try{foreach(var e in UnityEditor.EditorBuildSettings.scenes.Where(e=>e.enabled&&!e.path.Contains("MainMenu"))){var sc=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(e.path);foreach(var c in sc.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.PolygonCollider2D>()).Where(c=>!c.isTrigger&&c.GetComponentInParent<UnityEngine.Rigidbody2D>()==null)){var points=c.GetPath(0);bool axis=c.pathCount==1&&Enumerable.Range(0,points.Length).All(i=>UnityEngine.Mathf.Abs(points[i].x-points[(i+1)%points.Length].x)<.001f||UnityEngine.Mathf.Abs(points[i].y-points[(i+1)%points.Length].y)<.001f);rows.Add(sc.name+"|"+c.name+"|"+axis+"|"+c.bounds.ToString("F3")+"|"+c.transform.position.ToString("F3"));}}}finally{UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.RestoreSceneManagerSetup(setup);}System.IO.File.WriteAllLines("scripts/tilemap-grid-20261110/polygons.txt",rows);return rows.Count;
